categories.main_business_segments: Jiangsu Eazytec Information Technology Co., Ltd. primarily operates in three main business segments: cloud computing device core firmware business, cloud services business, and PB (PowerBuilder) business. The firmware business focuses on BIOS and BMC firmware development and sales for servers, PCs, and IoT devices. The cloud services segment provides customized cloud platform development, IoT cloud services, and integrated solutions mainly for government and enterprise clients. The PB business involves integrated development tools (IDE) and software sales, targeting global customers in finance, healthcare, government, and software industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages advanced BIOS and BMC firmware technologies compatible with multiple CPU architectures including x86, ARM, and RISC-V, emphasizing autonomous, secure, and controllable solutions. It develops integrated development environments (IDEs) such as PowerBuilder, PowerServer, and the cloud-native low-code IDE SnapDevelop, incorporating AI-assisted programming and cloud-native development methods. The firm also invests in cloud platform architectures using PaaS and SaaS models, AI model services (MaaS platform), and digital twin cloud platforms, employing modular development and AI integration for enhanced software and firmware products.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include major CPU and computing device manufacturers such as Intel, Huawei, Lenovo, Inspur, and H3C. The IDE products serve large enterprises, independent software vendors, and mid-sized companies primarily in North America, Europe, and Asia, with applications in finance, healthcare, government, and software sectors. Cloud services mainly target government agencies and enterprises within China, especially in Jiangsu province. The company also collaborates with global and domestic chip manufacturers and cloud service providers.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company operates primarily in China, with headquarters and major operations in Yixing, Jiangsu Province. It has subsidiaries and business presence in major Chinese cities including Nanjing, Beijing, Shanghai, Hangzhou, Xi'an, Shenzhen, and Hong Kong. Internationally, it serves customers in North America, Europe, and Asia, and has a subsidiary in the United States (Appeon Inc). The company maintains strategic partnerships with global firms like Intel and extends its market reach through overseas sales channels.
categories.supply_chain_position: Jiangsu Eazytec operates mainly in the midstream segment of the computing device supply chain, focusing on firmware development and software tools that are integral to CPU and computing hardware manufacturers. It provides core firmware solutions that enable hardware functionality and security, as well as software development tools and cloud services that support application development and deployment. The company also engages in downstream services by offering cloud solutions and customized software to end-user enterprises and government clients.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company prioritizes R&D in autonomous and secure firmware compatible with multiple CPU architectures, including RISC-V, to support domestic chip ecosystems. It invests heavily in AI integration across its IDE and cloud platforms, developing AI-assisted coding tools and intelligent firmware (AI BIOS). The firm focuses on expanding cloud-native and low-code development tools, enhancing AI capabilities in software development, and advancing digital twin and IoT cloud platforms. It also emphasizes talent development, patent acquisition, and participation in industry standards and open-source communities.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated through multiple streams: sales of firmware products and licensing fees, customized firmware development services, sales and licensing of integrated development tools (IDEs), subscription and licensing fees for software products, and cloud service contracts including platform development, resource leasing, and maintenance services. The company employs both direct sales and distribution channels, with some products offered via online platforms and others through strategic partnerships and agents.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: In the firmware market, the company competes with global leaders such as AMI, Phoenix, and Insyde, with a unique position as the only independent BIOS supplier supporting both international x86 and domestic CPU platforms. In the IDE market, it competes with major international products like Microsoft's Visual Studio and JetBrains Rider, with its SnapDevelop low-code IDE offering a domestically developed alternative focused on .NET cloud-native applications. The company holds a leading position domestically in firmware and IDE sectors, leveraging its autonomous technology and strategic partnerships to narrow gaps with international competitors.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company reported revenues of approximately RMB 323 million, showing a slight growth of 0.99% year-over-year. Net profit attributable to shareholders was RMB 32.8 million, a decline of 41.52% mainly due to reduced investment income. R&D investment increased by 16.09% to RMB 75.8 million, accounting for 23.45% of revenue. The company has total assets of about RMB 1.55 billion and equity attributable to shareholders of RMB 845 million. It has demonstrated steady growth in its PB business and maintains a strong R&D focus to support future expansion.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes its unique value proposition of providing autonomous, secure, and controllable firmware solutions compatible with multiple CPU architectures, including domestic RISC-V chips, supporting national information security strategies. Its IDE products, especially the SnapDevelop low-code cloud-native tool, offer high development efficiency, AI integration, and full intellectual property ownership, differentiating from foreign competitors. The firm’s cloud services integrate AI capabilities and digital twin technologies to deliver customized, scalable solutions. Its strong R&D capabilities, strategic partnerships with leading chip manufacturers, and comprehensive product ecosystem create competitive advantages in technology, security, and market reach.
